stages.headline: f is periodic with period T > 0 if f(x + T) = f(x) for every x; the graph repeats on every stretch of length T.
stages.headlineEnglish: f is periodic with period T > 0 if f(x + T) = f(x) for every x; the graph repeats on every stretch of length T.

stages.headline: sin x and cos x have smallest positive period 2π, tg x and ctg x have π; sin kx has period 2π/k.
stages.headlineEnglish: sin x and cos x have smallest positive period 2π, tg x and ctg x have π; sin kx has period 2π/k.

stages.headline: If T is a period, so are 2T, 3T, ...; e.g. sin 2x has smallest period π and cos(x/2) has 4π.
stages.headlineEnglish: If T is a period, so are 2T, 3T, ...; e.g. sin 2x has smallest period π and cos(x/2) has 4π.
